title: Dhoop may hai
body:
dhoop may hai qabre zehra gumbad e khizra ke paas
ye nabi karte hai nauha gumbad e khizra ke paas
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz se paala tha is ko thi meri noor e nazar
meri ummat ne jalaya hai meri beti ka dar
ye sitam zehra pe dhaaya gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye athara baras may ye huwe is par sitam
kaise kaise aur kya kya mil gaye zehra ko gham
hogayi zehra zaeefa gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah sabr e hyder tha ye kaise marhala
fatema zehra ko jo darbar bulwaya gaya
imtehan e murtaza tha gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera kalma padhne waale kar gaye kaisi jafa
jab gul e ismat ke upar jalta darwaza gira
hogaya pehlu shikasta gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbar o shabbir ko tum ne hai kaisa gham diya
haye bachon ke saron se maa ka saaya uth gaya
ro ke kehti thi ye fizza gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sada e mustafa hai baqer o safdar suno
koi qabre fatema zehra pe saaya to karo
dhoop may hai qabre zehra gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
author: Baqar Hussain
